product.name: Orderli QR Code Ordering Platform
product.description: A QR code-based ordering system allowing guests to scan a code at their table, view the menu, place orders, and send them directly to staff.

product.name: Orderli Integration Services
product.description: Integration of Orderli's ordering system with POS systems, payment gateways, and printers to streamline order processing and payment.

product.name: Orderli for Festivals
product.description: A standalone ordering system tailored for festivals, enabling cashless payments and offline operation without Wi-Fi.

product.name: Orderli for Hotels
product.description: An ordering system for hotels that supports room service with automatic service charges and flexible payment options.

product.name: Orderli for Restaurants and Bars
product.description: A QR code ordering solution for restaurants and bars that supports dynamic menus, allergen info, and payment flexibility.
